## Where

docs/privacy/ (its own one-page book), scripts/docs/, .github/workflows/docs.yml

## Goal

The privacy policy Google Play needs, at a stable URL (/privacy/) on the docs site, published as soon as it is written and outside the user book (spec 001 FR-006, plan D-015). One Markdown source, so F14 can bundle the same text in the app

## Done when

Page published at /privacy/; it states only what the app does today; Play checklist rows for the privacy policy cite it; owner merges
seen.title: Publish the privacy policy as its own page on the docs site
